annie.line: Thou wilt come no more, gentle Annie
stanza: 1 ContributorGentle Annie LyricsThis song is generally thought to be Foster’s e…
Thou wilt come no more, gentle Annie
Like a flower thy spirit did depart;
Thou are gone, alas! like the many
That have bloomed in the summer of my heart
You put the load right on me (You put the load right on me)
